paite: Pathian in hon hehpih henla, hon vualzawl henla, amel i tung uah hon vaksak hen. Selah
heading: Kipahthu Genna La

paite: Na lampi leitung a mi theih ahihtheih a, na hotdamna nam chih kiang a theih ahihtheihna ding in.
Pathian aw, michih in hon phat hen; mi khempeuhte'n hon phat hen.
Aw, namte kipaktak a om in, nopla sa uhen; nang michih khentuam nei lou a vai hawmsak in, leitung a namte na uk ngal a. Selah
Pathian aw, michih in hon phat uhen; mi chitengte'n hon phat uhen.
Lei in athilpou apia a; Pathian, koumau Pathian ngei in, ahon vualzawl ding.
Pathian in hon vualzawl ding a; kawlmong a mi tengteng in leng amah alau ding uhi.
